title: Roundtrip
prompt: Write profile(text) that parses a JSON string into a dict and returns the value at key "city". json.loads is your friend.

tests.name: parses and extracts
tests.code: assert profile(chr(123) + chr(34) + "city" + chr(34) + ": " + chr(34) + "Hanoi" + chr(34) + chr(125)) == "Hanoi", "extract the city"
